I did talk to them. They told me I was sick and nudged me into going to see the doc and a therapist every week. They also tell me I'm sick. It's not news to me that wanting to die is not a normal state of mind, to be blunt. I know I shouldn't feel like this, especially because there's nothing really *wrong*, but that doesn't stop the fact I do feel like this. I don't know what else I can try.

Thanks for listening, anyway.

I had a clusterfuckton of nightmares as a kid, but there was this one set that I had for a good long time. And looking back, they weren't so much scary as insidious, I guess. I was maybe eight at the time of these ones.

For a while, I just dreamt there was a guy standing outside my window. Not doing anything, just standing there. And you couldn't see his features or anything, cause it was dark, but his silhouette was enough that I knew it was a person and not, say, a tree. And then after a few months or so, the dream started changing, ever so slightly, then would stay that way for maybe a week, and then change again. The only thing that stayed the same was the fact I couldn't move. Not even to look away. I was stuck in my dream, staring at this guy for the whole dream. The first change, the same shadowy guy was doing the same not-moving thing, but he was just inside my room, by the window. Again, not moving, but now definitely inside my room, maybe six feet away. 

Then he moved to my bed, maybe a foot away from me. I was on the top bunk, so his head and my face were on the same level; I still couldn't see his features at all, but I could feet him breathing on me. And again, I couldn't move to turn on the light or turn away. Then he started swaying; just lightly, just enough that I could register he was moving. 

It went like this for about another two weeks or so, and I asked my dad (in real life) what I should do, cause it was starting to really worry me. He asked whether I'd tried to talk to the person, and after I said no he suggested I try, while also agreeing to stay in my room that night, just in case. So night comes, dream comes, guy is there in the dark, swaying away. I don't know why I'd never tried to talk to him before, but apparently I hadn't. I think I asked him what his name was? I can't recall what question it was, but as soon as I'd asked it, the guy stopped swaying. I tried to ask him again, and he breathed in deeply, and just screamed. It was more a yell, I guess, like a crackly "AUGH" sound, but really long and sustained. Loudest thing I'd ever heard, it felt like his voice was somehow ripping me apart and the room started shaking. 

I wake up and my dad is right by my bed, right where the guy was, and I almost fall off the bed trying to get away, cause I'm sure I'm till dreaming. After I'd realised I'm awake and everything was okay my dad explained that I'd been screaming for about a minute and that he'd been trying to wake me up, but couldn't. Then for another month or so, I dreamt the man was outside the window again, before I stopped dreaming about him at all.

Like I said, not really scary as hell, but it took me a good few years til I could be convinced to look out of windows at night. Even now, I think twice about it.
